delegation.scope: R9 prospective read-only OPPO A74/P9a device data source inventory and offline hardware/software calibration design, no production changes
allowed_actions: Read previously authorized source copies and manifests
Validate hashes and exact data provenance
Develop isolated offline sensor and SR-UKF calibration candidates
prohibited_actions: No capture or app interrupt or live sensor-rate modification
No new device worker, Hostinger write, or device calibration firmware edit
No public raw IMU data or private VM transfer
No R3 reopening or unapproved production rollout
No unauthenticated expert GitHub write or scientific promotion

mission.question: Which hardware bias/timebase and SR-UKF Q/R calibration improvements are identifiable, falsifiable and reproducible on original trusted OPPO A74 / Pixel 9a data without disturbing existing capture?
deliverables: R9 independent source inventory and original-byte gap register
Read-only per-device timing, bias and sensor calibration capability ledger
Preregistered offline SR-UKF baseline and null evaluation design
Negative fixtures, exact executed-versus-unexecuted receipt and detached manifest
falsifiers: Unaccounted timestamp discontinuity or device timebase mix
Train and heldout data overlap or posthoc thresholding
Numerical SPD breakdown or invalid NIS/NEES prerequisite
Public disclosure of private raw data
acceptance_tests: Exact predecessor source rehash and scoped R8 closure recorded
Noninterference with live OPPO capture established for every executed action
Frozen baseline and independent heldout protocol or honest NOT_COMPUTABLE
No external GitHub actor privilege without operator slot
pause_conditions: Source not physically accessible while capture active => scoped hold
Missing six-orientation truth => full accelerometer calibration NOT_COMPUTABLE
Unauthorized runtime write or secret disclosure => security hold
not_executed: New device capture or Soak redo
Real per-package independent Hostinger original ZIP readback
New SR-UKF empirical heldout calibration run

drift_triggers: Unauthorized device interaction or scope expansion

provenance.copyright_privacy: Only public-safe hashes and research designs; no raw OPPO phone ZIP, personal data, secrets or private Cursor VM snapshots

functionality_performance: Source IDs and byte-pair mapping computable or marked NOT_COMPUTABLE
Calibration candidate improvement scored only on genuine locked heldout dataset
robustness_stability: No active capture interruption or production calibration write
Proposed negative fixtures and covariance SPD failures documented
traceability_comprehensibility: Uploaded original sources and SHA-256 locally checked
Operator R8 work-phase closure separated from other R8 research namespaces and R7 gates
